data.name: Ramkumar
data.gender_notes: Ramkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ramkumar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ram' meaning God Rama, and 'Kumar' meaning protector. The name signifies a strong and loyal protector of God Rama. The name Ramkumar carries the meaning “God Rama's protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Tamil. Parents who choose Ramkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody god rama's protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ramkumar symbolizes the divine protection of the Almighty God Rama. It is believed that the name instills courage, strength, and loyalty in the bearer, making them a powerful and protective presence in any situation.
